verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly advertises an 'API, CLI, SDK and MCP' platform (warp-docs-42), and a live probe confirms a real OpenAPI spec is served at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json (warp-probe-2), backed by a documented CLI reference (warp-probe-3) and API-key based headless auth for the Oz CLI (warp-docs-63) plus scriptable agent control (warp-docs-22, warp-docs-37, warp-docs-52). Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of API usage and more detailed public API reference content beyond the openapi.json existence check.
